headline: Would a cheaper model have worked for gpt-5.4's calls?
subhead: 21 production calls replayed on Mini and Flash. Mini (gpt-5-mini) costs 82% less per call than gpt-5.4. This run has no noise floor, so differences are shown without production's own variation.
